claims.text: Semantic density extracts uncertainty/confidence information for each response from a probability distribution perspective in semantic space.
Semantic density has no restriction on task types.
Semantic density is off-the-shelf for new models and tasks.
Semantic density demonstrates superior performance compared to prior approaches on four free-form question-answering benchmarks.
Semantic density demonstrates robustness compared to prior approaches on four free-form question-answering benchmarks.

evidence.description: Experiments on seven state-of-the-art LLMs, including the latest Llama 3 and Mixtral-8x22B models, on four free-form question-answering benchmarks demonstrate the superior performance and robustness of semantic density compared to prior approaches.

methodologies.name: Semantic density
methodologies.description: Extracts uncertainty and confidence information for each LLM response from a probability distribution perspective in semantic space.

limitations.text: Prior uncertainty quantification methods are restricted to classification tasks.
Prior uncertainty quantification methods require additional training and data.
Prior uncertainty quantification methods consider only lexical instead of semantic information.
Prior uncertainty quantification methods are prompt-wise but not response-wise.
